subject: geography

items.correct: The zigzag movement of sediment along a coast caused by waves approaching at an angle (swash up the beach) and gravity returning water perpendicular (backwash).
items.misconception: Sand moves along the beach because tides pull it sideways.
items.random_wrong: Longshore drift is the rising of sea level over time.
items.why: Students confuse tides with waves. Longshore drift is a wave-driven process — the angle of swash vs straight-down backwash creates the zigzag, not tidal pull.

items.q: Which method involves planting marram grass?
items.why: Correct answer: Dune regeneration. “Groynes” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: What is a problem with using groynes?
items.why: Correct answer: They cause downdrift erosion. “They are illegal” sounds right because it borrows the language of the topic — but it fails this question. Re-read the notes on why.

items.q: Roughly how much does a sea wall cost per metre (£)?
items.why: The real figure is 6000. The wrong options cluster deliberately close — anchor the exact number to one concrete fact so it can't drift.
